en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.title: Trusted Locations
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.keywords: trust trusted safe mode folder location workspace project remote ssh host container
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.foldersHelp: Projects anywhere inside these folders open trusted without asking, except the ones you chose to keep in safe mode. Changes take effect when you click Apply or OK.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.empty: No trusted locations. Lithe asks before opening each project you haven't trusted.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.rootLocation: A disk or filesystem root cannot be a trusted location: it would trust every project on that disk.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.listFull: This trust list is full (256 entries). Remove one before adding another.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteHelp: Folders on hosts you trusted or chose to keep in safe mode, recorded per connection and kept only on this machine. A record here never applies to local projects or to other hosts. After a record is removed, opening the folder asks again. Changes take effect when you click Apply or OK; a remote workspace that is already open keeps its trust until it is opened again.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteEmpty: No remote folder has a trust record. Lithe asks before opening a host folder you haven’t decided on.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteConflict: The remote trust records changed elsewhere and were read again. Click Apply once more; the removals that still name a record were kept.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteDamaged: The remote trust records (toolchains/remote-trust.json in the settings folder) cannot be read. Repair or remove the file before removing records.

zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.title: 可信位置
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.keywords: 信任 可信 安全模式 文件夹 位置 工作区 项目 远程 主机 容器
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.foldersHelp: 这些文件夹内任意层级的项目都直接以信任方式打开，不再询问；你选择保持安全模式的项目除外。点击“应用”或“确定”后生效。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.empty: 没有可信位置。打开尚未信任的项目时会先询问。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.rootLocation: 磁盘或文件系统的根目录不能作为可信位置，否则会信任该磁盘上的所有项目。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.listFull: 信任列表已满（最多 256 项），请先删除一项再添加。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteHelp: 你在主机上信任或选择保持安全模式的文件夹，按连接分别记录，只保存在本机；这里的记录不会作用于本机项目或其他主机。删除一条记录后，下次打开该文件夹会再次询问。点击“应用”或“确定”后生效；已经打开的远程工作区要重新打开后才按新的记录处理。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteEmpty: 还没有远程文件夹的信任记录。打开尚未决定的主机文件夹时会先询问。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteConflict: 远程工作区的信任记录在别处被修改过，已重新读取。请再点击一次“应用”；仍然对应现有记录的删除草稿已保留。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.remoteDamaged: 无法读取远程工作区的信任记录（设置目录中的 toolchains/remote-trust.json）。修复或删除这个文件之前不能删除记录。
